description: This file defines the internal sealed class 'Gateway' which manages client connections, routing, and communication in the Orleans runtime. It includes functionalities for handling connections, routing messages, performing maintenance tasks, and caching client routing information.

classes.name: Gateway
classes.description: Manages client connections, message routing, and maintenance within the Orleans runtime.

classes.name: ClientState
classes.description: Represents the state of a client connection, including connection management and message queue.

classes.name: ClientsReplyRoutingCache
classes.description: Caches the routing information for reply messages back to clients to optimize message routing.

methods.name: PerformGatewayMaintenance
methods.description: Performs periodic maintenance tasks such as dropping disconnected clients and cleaning cached entries.

methods.name: SendStopSendMessages
methods.description: Instructs clients to stop sending messages and shuts down the gateway.

methods.name: RecordClosedConnection
methods.description: Records the closing of a client connection.

methods.name: DropDisconnectedClients
methods.description: Drops clients that have disconnected for longer than the drop timeout.

methods.name: TryDeliverToProxy
methods.description: Routes messages to client proxies if applicable.

methods.name: IsTargetingLocalGateway
methods.description: Checks if a given SiloAddress targets the local gateway.
